\begin{abstract}
A fixture for multi-file source mapping via flatten-tex markers.
\end{abstract}

% [flatten-tex.py] inlined: chapters/chapter01.tex
% chapter01.tex — chapter for the multi-file meaty-claim fixture.
%
% The claim and its paired evidence both live in this file; after
% flatten-tex inlines them into main.tex, the parser's SourceMap must
% map the flat-source positions back to this filename and to the
% original-file line numbers.

\section{The first chapter}
\label{sec:ch1}

\begin{claim}[Proposition: the squares stack]
\label{prop:stack}
The squares of consecutive integers differ by an odd number.
\end{claim}

\begin{evidence}[Proof of stack]
\label{ev:stack}
% [flatten-tex.py] MISSING: figures/fig-stack
\input{figures/fig-stack}
For any integer $n$, the identity $(n+1)^2 - n^2 = 2n + 1$ holds.
Since $2n + 1$ is odd for any integer $n$, the difference is odd.
\dependson{stack}{post:arith}
\end{evidence}
% [flatten-tex.py] end: chapters/chapter01.tex
